priorityList: Apply Sunfire if targets will live approximately 5 seconds and Apply Moonfire if targets will live 6 seconds
Press Force outside of Eclipse if the next ability is Cast Celestial Alignment
Cast Celestial Alignment if Force was just cast, then Cast Starfire to Spend Dream Surge if you will not cap on Astral Power
If not entering cooldowns, Enter Lunar Eclipse if hitting 4+ targets, else Enter Solar Eclipse
Spend Dream Surge using Cast Starfire unless you will cap on Astral Power
Cast Starfall to spend Astral Power and do not cap on Astral Power
Cast Starfire to generate Astral Power
Cast Convoke before casting other Starfalls on multiple targets to raise the chance of casting a free Starfall
Cast Wrath to enter Solar Eclipse
Cast Starfire to enter Lunar Eclipse
